verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a REST API and an MCP server that makes authenticated API calls, but nothing documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys, such as read-only or per-project secret keys, for an agent. The read-only SDK Connection Endpoint is an SDK payload key, not an agent API credential. 'Advanced permissioning/access control' on the pricing page refers to user roles without mention of API credentials, so both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
